name: In Search of Thaelrid
summary: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass sends you into Blackfathom Deeps to find the scout who went missing there. The Argent Dawn fears naga and Twilight's Hammer cultists have joined forces in the flooded ruins.

sections.title: Eyes in Darnassus
sections.body: The Argent Dawn watches for threats across Kalimdor as well as the Scourge in Lordaeron. Dawnwatcher Shaedlass gathers reports from Darnassus about unnatural dangers. Word reaches him that naga and the doomsday zealots of the Twilight's Hammer have made a pact in Blackfathom Deeps, the flooded ruins along the Ashenvale shore. The order fears what this alliance could bring.

sections.title: The Missing Scout
sections.body: Argent Guard Thaelrid entered the caverns to investigate the coastal rumors. Weeks have passed without word, and Shaedlass's other scouts are away on separate operations. He fears Thaelrid has fallen or been captured by the dark powers beneath the waves. Now he asks you to enter Blackfathom Deeps and bring the missing scout back alive.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn interested in Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn watches for threats across Azeroth, including dangers beyond the undead of the Eastern Kingdoms. Naga joining forces with Twilight's Hammer cultists in Kalimdor demands the order's attention.

Dawnwatcher Shaedlass is an Argent Dawn operative in Darnassus, the night elf capital. He gathers information, finds where the order's aid is needed, and sends investigators to assess regional crises.
Argent Guard Thaelrid is an Argent Dawn operative sent to investigate Blackfathom Deeps. He was sent to learn the strength and intent of the naga and cultists in the drowned caverns.
Argent Guard Thaelrid is deep inside Blackfathom Deeps, along the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale. He has infiltrated the caverns and waits there alone for reinforcements.
When Thaelrid is found, he reveals the true nature of the ritual in the ruins and points you toward the cult's leaders in Blackfathom Villainy.

faq.q: Can Horde players take this mission?
faq.answer: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass gives the assignment in Darnassus, and it is aimed at Alliance adventurers. Horde adventurers can accept it if they reach him.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you can begin serving alongside the Argent Dawn and earn its goodwill.
As a night elf, you know the ancient Temple of Elune in Blackfathom Deeps has been defiled. Helping the Argent Dawn means recovering sacred night elven heritage.
As a paladin aligned with the Argent Dawn, you recognize Thaelrid's lonely vigil as a solemn duty to guard the world against shadow and corruption.
